DESCRIPTION:
Create a new standalone business module

USAGE:
    modulus module [name] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    modulus module Catalog --app MyApp

ARGUMENTS:
    [name]    Name of the module (e.g. Catalog, Orders). Omit to be prompted

OPTIONS:
                              DEFAULT                                           
    -h, --help                           Prints help information                
        --dry-run                        Preview what would happen: report file 
                                         writes / commands without executing    
                                         them                                   
        --force                          Overwrite existing files without       
                                         prompting / skip confirmations         
    -v, --verbose                        Show detailed output (child-process    
                                         stdout, every written file, etc.)      
    -q, --quiet                          Suppress everything but errors and the 
                                         final summary                          
        --app                            Root namespace of the application (e.g.
                                         MyApp). Auto-detected when omitted     
    -o, --output              ./         Output directory                       
    -d, --database                       Database provider: SQLite (default),   
                                         SqlServer, PostgreSQL, MySQL           
        --migration-engine               Migration engine: efcore (default),    
                                         dbsh. Omit to inherit from the app's   
                                         existing modules
